standing: Leads the AFC East by 3.5 games

lastGame.title: Bills 31, Jets 12
stats: Josh Allen: 11-of-21, 196 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT; 2 rushing TDs (both 1 yard); passed Peyton Manning for most total TDs in a player's first 10 seasons
James Cook III: 18 carries, 157 yards, 74-yard TD run (career long, Bills' longest rushing TD since 2016)
DJ Moore: 4 catches, 90 yards, 45-yard TD; Dalton Kincaid had a career-long 54-yard catch
Defense: no TDs allowed, Jets 3-of-13 on third down; T.J. Parker 2 sacks, Dorian Williams first career sack
Jets QBs: Geno Smith 13-of-21, 148 yards before an ankle injury; rookie Cade Klubnik 11-of-20, 137 yards, 1 INT

news.h: Benford could play Sunday despite groin
news.b: CB Christian Benford (groin) likely won't practice Wednesday but could still play against Miami. Joe Brady said Wednesday will be just a walkthrough and the team will progress injured players day by day.

news.h: Alford in protocol, Williams has calf injury
news.b: DB Dee Alford must clear the concussion protocol before Sunday. LB Dorian Williams (calf) left in the fourth quarter after a team-high 9 tackles. LBs Terrel Bernard and Joe Andreessen had postgame X-rays, per The Buffalo News.

Miami (1-8) fell 24-22 at Indianapolis. Kyle McCord, starting for Malik Willis (IR, groin), went 17-of-32 for 209 yards with a rushing TD. He was sacked on the final drive. Miami visits Highmark on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET on CBS.

news.h: Patriots fall to 5-5, Bills lead by 3.5
news.b: New England lost 35-10 to Detroit in Munich after Drake Maye was hurt early, and has a Week 11 bye. WR Tyrell Shavers (knee, PUP) wasn't activated for the Jets game and could debut against Miami.

source: Rochester D&C via Yahoo and SI Bills Central injury outlooks (Nov 16); buffalobills.com injury update (Nov 15); Field Level Media Colts-Dolphins recap (Nov 15); patriots.com Week 10 recap (Nov 15); CBS Sports/RotoWire Shavers note (Nov 14); Monday Nov 16 game was Chargers-Ravens (no AFC East team).
